Server predecrements signed warmup on every tick, enters the active branch only below0, and queries inflated0.2 horizontal bounding box LivingEntities only at exactly-8. A newly constructed warmup0 fangs reaches damage on its eighth entity tick. Then event4 is broadcast only if sentSpikeEvent false, then lifeTicks decrements and discards below0; initial22 allows23 active negative-warmup ticks, not23 total ticks independent of initial warmup.

Saved warmup-7 reaches damage at the next tick; a fresh entity loaded with saved-8 predecrements to-9 and never catches that exact damage point absent external mutation.
